summary.name: Oscilloscope Graphics (Digital and 3D Aesthetics; provenance explicit). Source describes a dark field with a small set of glowing vector traces.
summary.visualIdentity: Dark field with few glowing vector traces for waveforms, trajectories and contours. Modest persistence keeps paths clear. Paths come from defined signals or precomputed audio, not arbitrary wobble. Stable zones are reserved for text. Raster CRT scanlines are excluded.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: audio-reactive or Lissajous pieces driven by a real signal, and signal-processing education using explicit functions such as sine sums. Inferred: music visualizers or offline backdrops, only when the signal data is verified. Unspecified: the task subject and audience.
summary.limitations: Requires defined signal behavior; a simulated trace is not a physical measurement. Live microphone input is unsuitable for rendered output. Strobing brightness on every beat should be avoided. Crossing traces can become illegible. Two-color contrast checks do not verify text over animated traces. Duration, copy and aspect ratio are unspecified placeholders.
summary.palette: Background policy is scene_dependent, so #081613 is only an illustrative swatch and not a required canvas color. Suggested tokens: foreground #D8F0DD for labels and accent #76CF9B reserved for traces. Status is a style-compatible suggestion, not approved colors. Gradients are disabled. Contrast: foreground on background 15.362:1; accent on background 9.845:1 (two-color checks only).
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit: traces follow a defined signal or precomputed audio; persistence and line weight stay constant; section boundaries switch figure families. Video runs on composition time with no pointer input. Optional references (motion-012, -014, -015, -039) must be screened for scene fit; none is required. Motion-039 (white and dark confetti, palette inversion) conflicts with the glowing-vector identity, so it is inferred unsuitable unless the scene has a matching mark.
summary.audio: The source specifies no fixed audio layer; choices are task-specific. Music-sync pairing suggests a precomputed beat or section table that drives trace changes. Explanatory pieces may use silence or restrained ambience. Voiceover and music requirements are unspecified. Web Audio serves preview inspection only; offline renders should use precomputed data. Any soundtrack must be real measured audio.
summary.assetRequirements: No uploaded assets are specified. Needed inputs are a verified audio file with analysis data, or explicit mathematical functions for traces. Fonts must be local and loaded before rendering. Text needs reserved stable zones in the foreground token. Any supplied approved colors override the suggested tokens. Exact copy and product marks are unspecified.
summary.combinations: style-105 (music-sync): a shared beat and section table drives trace changes, with fixed persistence and text in stable zones. style-097 (data labels): a faint graticule and readouts for sine sums or Lissajous ratios, where formulas must match plotted functions and the accent is reserved for traces. Avoid scanlines and crossing multi-trace layouts.
summary.productionApproach: Style renderer: Canvas 2D draws traces from explicit functions or precomputed signals. Motion engine: GSAP paused timeline or deterministic functions, with one owner per property. Pipeline: HyperFrames is the default; Remotion only when a documented limitation applies. chroma-js is optional for validation. Verify forward, backward and direct seeks and audio sync.
